import 'dart:io';
import 'package:crawlberg/crawlberg.dart';
import 'package:crawlberg/src/crawlberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final engine = await CrawlbergBridge.createEngine();
    final url = 'https://example.com';
    final result = await CrawlbergBridge.scrape(engine, url);
    stdout.writeln(result.statusCode);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.title);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.canonicalUrl);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.keywords);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.author);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.viewport);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.generator);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.themeColor);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.robots);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.htmlLang);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.htmlDir);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
